svg.title: A task that needs input
svg.desc: The agent asks for a permission, the task reports input-required, and the client answers on the same taskId.
svg.text: an a2a-sdk app, or OpenCode's a2a tool
C2 · SendMessage that runs into a permission prompt

text.tspan: the prompt is delivered, the agent runs
the agent's shell call waits for a reply
read(): working, and pending() finds the permission

g.text: the shell tool runs, the turn goes on

text.tspan: the turn ends, the Session goes idle
task COMPLETED, same taskId as before

svg.text: Shaded bar: a request still open (client side) or a wait on Bus events (handler side). Pills are messages; boxes are steps inside one component.
